shared_frame_findings.transforms: 665 master;662 (+155,+200);664 x+100,y*.953+168;661 .777+(470,172). Multiple columns, main stairs, single-X/paired-X/compartments align. These are drawing registration approximations, not metre dimensions or measured setbacks.

shared_frame_findings.main_topology: Occupied central 3F is solid-use proxy, not courtyard. Upper cross and lower recessed balcony relationship is directionally consistent.

required_revisions.finding: v1 generator has cut=None and no actual entry recess; rendered lower facade is ordinary repeated glazing. Source658 requires a real entrance setback, doors and bounded fascia/canopy.
required_revisions.requested: Build the true source-bound entrance opening/doors and attached fascia at the selected plan interface, not merely a material patch. Preserve separate genuine exterior interfaces.

required_revisions.finding: v1 southeast short straight stairs do not follow the broad bent exterior stair interface drawn in662.
required_revisions.requested: Retain the complete building-attached southeast turn/broad stair and landing, with connected side-ramp termination; do not arbitrarily truncate stair flights. Exact step count/heights may be explicit approximation.

required_revisions.finding: West plinth starts at z1.15 while partial basement only supports the eastern footprint; v1 elevation/rear and independent west views show an unsupported-looking whole western lower edge. Comment risinggrade is not actual grade geometry.
required_revisions.requested: Provide bounded contact footing/grade to the common base without inventing a complete B1 room volume or filling actual exterior balcony/column airspace. No generic displayplate required.

required_revisions.finding: 665 shows deeper exterior grey projection strips north of y208 and west of x225; roof=occupied window outline omits these. Photo659 strongly supports the main 3F cantilever and underside structure; additional above-window eave depth is less certain. v1 bevel is limited to bottom z9..9.82 while photographed white return edge splays over much of the top-storey height.
required_revisions.requested: Retain north/west source-evidenced deeper projections and only bounded thin east/south edges unless independently supported. Do not mirror deep eaves to all sides merely for the camera candidate. Improve visible side-edge splay as a declared coarse geometric approximation, then compare source angles.

photographic_registration.preferred_candidate: 658 east face from southeast and659 same east face from northeast; entry left and corner relationship plausibly fit southeast external access.
photographic_registration.independent_countertest: Globally180-opposite west views also reproduce nearly symmetric main mass relationships. Archived v1 has regularized similar facades and cannot uniquely disambiguate sides; stairs and a roof enclosure alone are not a compass proof.
photographic_registration.rule: Do not move or mirror plan-proven asymmetric eaves/B1 merely to enforce the east candidate. One unchanged model and both views, candid description of relative-side uncertainty.
photographic_registration.visible_small_roof_enclosure: A low finite proxy may represent the visible659 enclosure if positioned conservatively, with use/precise position unknown; never infer elevator machinery from paired-X symbols or invent multiple towers.

nonblocking_limits: Fine unseen windows and materials may be restrained regularized proxies but are not photo-proved on all four sides.
No separate RF: bounded roof closure is acceptable, not surveyed reconstruction.
